articles.title: Create an AI Podcast Generator with ElevenLabs
articles.summary: Introduction Podcasts have exploded in popularity, but producing a high‑quality episode still takes a lot of time—recording, editing, and finding a consistent voice. What if you could turn a script into a polished episode with a single API call? In this guide we’ll build an AI Podcast Generator that takes raw text, feeds it to a text‑to‑speech (TTS) engine, and spits out an MP3 ready for publishing. The star of the show is ElevenLabs, a cutting‑edge voice AI platform that offers realistic voice cloning and a simple REST API. By the end of this article you’ll have a runnable Python script (and a handy curl example) that can generate a 30‑minute episode in under a minute. Why ElevenLabs? • Natural‑sounding voices that rival human narrators • Easy-to‑use API with per‑character pricing (free tier for testing) • Voice cloning lets you keep the same host voice across episodes Ready to give your podcast a voice? articles.title: Meta Bets on AI, Devices for Its Next Chapter
articles.summary: Meta is experimenting with new ways to move beyond its social media roots, from the fast-growing Muse AI assistant to smart glasses and its new palm-sized Charm device. eMarketer Senior Analyst Minda Smiley discusses whether Muse marks a turning point for Meta’s AI strategy, why the company is testing multiple hardware form factors, and whether its latest products have staying power or risk becoming another short-lived technology fad. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

articles.title: The dark art of maths and the AI revolution | Letter
articles.summary: Bev Littlewood reminds us that mathematics has been the prime driver of the rise in AI, in response to an editorialYou report in your leader that some mathematicians feel discomfiture at the AI solution to a Navier-Stokes problem (The Guardian view on AI v mathematicians: humans are still vital to the field, but tech firms refuse to see that, 20 September). I fear that they have been hoist by their own petard: mathematics, after all, has been the prime mover of the AI revolution.As a somewhat lowly mathematician, let me remind others of the famous quote of Augustine: “The good Christian should beware the mathematician and all those who make empty promises. The danger already exists that the mathematicians have made a covenant with the devil to darken the spirit and to confine man in the bonds of hell.” Continue reading...
